_readme: Copy this to ~/.claude/engram-sync-config.json and fill in your details. install.ps1 fills workspace_path automatically.
_base_relative_note: Path inside My Drive where the engram-sync folder lives. Change only if you used a different folder structure during /engram-drive setup.
_workspace_path_note: Your local Odoo development root. install.ps1 auto-detects this. Each team member sets their own path — never hardcoded.
